basics.name: Du Ouyang
basics.label: Postdoctoral Researcher at CMAP, École Polytechnique
basics.summary: Postdoctoral researcher at CMAP, École Polytechnique, working with Prof. Huyên Pham. Ph.D. in Mathematics with Distinction from Tsinghua University. My research interests are numerical analysis, stochastic control, reinforcement learning, machine learning, and quasi-Monte Carlo methods.
